text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Who do you think it is?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Isn't it gotta be Vodka?

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
No way, didn't you see Daiwa Scarlet's press scrum?
She had an incredible fire in her eyes.

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
When all's said and done, isn't Aston Machan the one to watch?
Her Fillies' Revue was amazing, after all.

"A clash of the Big Three where
anyone could emerge victorious."

"Bathed in cherry blossom pink, Hanshin Racecourse
eagerly awaited
the decisive battle that was about to begin."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Phew...... ngh!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I studied Chan-chan's races thoroughly.
I felt Vodka's explosive power firsthand.
I came prepared with a plan, too.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna take it...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"WOOOOOOOO!
All right!!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
We've done everything we can!
All that's left is to blow 'em all away!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
“I won't lose in a neck-and-neck fight.
Not to Scarlet, not to Chan...
I refuse to lose that final step...!”

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: It's mine!!

While a tense atmosphere hung in the air
around the waiting rooms,
Aston Machan, on the other hand—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Mmuh...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: "...I thought I had become friends with spring, but I was mistaken."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Restless, floating, tingling... Ever since yesterday, I just can't shake it.
choice_data_list: Will you be able to run in the race?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Of course.
Even if the sky comes falling down, Machan will be there.
Even so, sending her out like this is worrying. Isn't there something that could put her mind at ease?
Turning my bag inside out, I luckily found a piece of candy and turned back to hand it over—only to find, as expected...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Wobbling, dizzy, ...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...No, I will ignore it for now.
If it does not exist, then it simply is not there.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Today, a thousand eyes will gaze upon the turf.
Today, a legend will be born.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: In that case.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Even if spring looks away from me...
Chan-chan will still claim it...!
